response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), cross_rating AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) AS mean_per_day_price FROM rating_averages) SELECT AVG(r.avg_length) AS avg_length, AVG(r.per_day_price) AS avg_per_day_price, AVG(r.per_day_price - c.mean_per_day_price) AS avg_excess_per_day_price FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN cross_rating AS c WHERE r.per_day_price > c.mean_per_day_price
